policies.summary: The college maintains an active Training & Placement Cell with leading MNC recruiters including TCS, Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Capgemini, HCL, and Tech Mahindra.
policies.details: DVR & Dr. HS MIC College of Technology has a proven placement track record. Top recruiting partners include Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Capgemini, HCL Technologies, Tech Mahindra, Hexaware, Virtusa, and Mindtree. Packages range up to ₹10-12 LPA for product and specialized roles, with an average package of ₹4.0 - 4.5 LPA across eligible engineering branches.
policies.actionable: Register on the Placement Portal during the 6th semester and upload verified academic resumes.

policies.topic: Campus Recruitment Training (CRT) and Skill Development
policies.summary: Comprehensive Campus Recruitment Training (CRT) begins from the 2nd year covering quantitative aptitude, reasoning, coding, and verbal communication.
policies.details: The college organizes intensive coding bootcamps on Python, Java, Data Structures & Algorithms, LeetCode, and HackerRank problem solving. Pre-placement mock interviews, group discussions (GD), and resume reviews are conducted by industry experts before the placement season.
policies.actionable: Attendance is mandatory in all scheduled CRT sessions for placement registration eligibility.

policies.summary: Students must have a minimum aggregate CGPA of 6.0 with no standing backlogs to participate in campus recruitment drives.
policies.details: Most tier-1 MNCs require 60% or 6.5 CGPA in 10th, 12th/Diploma, and B.Tech with no active arrears. Once a student secures an offer, they can only apply for dream companies offering at least 1.5x of their current offer package.
policies.actionable: Clear all backlogs before the start of the 7th semester to qualify for Day-1 hiring drives.
